grade_reason: No statement by Jeremy Moss about AI risk, or about AI itself, was found since 1 January 2025; the only related item is a campaign-site line about Michigan data center regulations, which is about data centers rather than AI.
notes: 8 web searches ran, none refused. No sources show Moss sponsoring or co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (he was not a House member) or signing any letter about AI risk. His campaign priorities page (https://votejeremymoss.com/priorities/, undated, read at source) says: "Our Democratic majority passed and I voted for the strongest regulations around data centers of any state in the country." Left out of statements because it is about data centers (level D under ruling 5) and has no date; a reviewer could choose to record it as a D statement, which would make the grade D. Rival primary candidate Don Ufford's campaign attacked Moss over AI-industry super PAC spending (about $300,000) for him and over votes for data-center tax breaks in the state legislature; the Ufford page now returns 404 and this is a partisan characterization, not Moss's words. A Planet Detroit voter guide lists a Detroit Free Press headline from 29 July ("AI backers spending in support of Jeremy Moss' US House race"); I did not find or open that article. The Planet Detroit guide had no candidate questionnaire answers on AI. The site: search on the campaign site did not return pages from that site, so the campaign homepage and priorities page were opened directly instead.
